C0262.title: Individuals Posing as Delivery Riders to Stage Sob Stories for Traffic Fined
C0262.summary: In Qinzhou, Guangxi, Wang, a former delivery worker, conspired with team members Huang and Liang to stage and post fake videos of 'rider-customer quarrels' across multiple platforms to attract followers and drive sales.
